batch: C03c executed WebAssembly numerical and state contracts
implementation: The existing 18 core integration tests register with wasm-bindgen-test on wasm32 and the standard Rust harness on native targets. Oracles, cases and tolerances are shared unchanged.

WASM-only dev dependencies select the existing workspace test runner and the JavaScript entropy backend for proptest/rand 0.9/getrandom 0.3. The core production dependency still uses getrandom 0.4. No solver or shipping API changed.
The existing Firefox CI job now executes all four core test targets in an optimized dedicated worker with wasm,veriloga-wasm-jit and no default features, matching the worker core feature selection.

environment.timeout_scope: Test-runner timeout in seconds, not a measured performance acceptance limit.
environment.node: No browser/worker mode override; default runner Node environment.
environment.webdriver: CHROMEDRIVER selects the downloaded driver; WASM_BINDGEN_TEST_WEBDRIVER_JSON selects the installed Chrome binary. Headless mode retained; driver uses an isolated test profile.

coverage.bjt_excess_phase_transient: Both phase laws, three dialects, NPN/PNP, OP/UIC; independent exact-delay refinement and temperature/area/multiplicity oracles; packed/unpacked exact continuation, horizon extension, compression, invalid and unresolvable arrivals, cancellation and reuse.
coverage.gp_phase_regimes: Independent nonlinear I_BE/Q_B and diffusion-charge derivative under saturation, reverse-active and high injection, both polarities/all dialects; exact-delay refinement, separate Weil recurrence and terminal KCL. Numerical limits remain those in core-gp-regimes-windows-20261005.json.
coverage.gp_history_resources: 32-bit WASM transport-byte budget boundaries, aggregate device/history/checkpoint-copy accounting, typed refusal, successful reuse and unchanged caller checkpoint after failed restoration.
coverage.gp_phase_cancellation: Cancellation after accepted work, no later accepted sample, bit-identical reuse and unchanged checkpoint/final continuation.
coverage.scope: Repeated executions exercise the same 18 named tests; do not sum runs as distinct tests. These are native GP device cases even when the Verilog-A feature set is enabled.
